steps: Draw the Lewis structure and count electron groups on the center. A bond (any order) is one group. A lone pair is one group.
2 groups: linear, 180°. 3 groups: trigonal planar, 120°. 4 groups: tetrahedral, 109.5°.
The shape name ignores lone pairs. One lone pair on a tetrahedral center is trigonal pyramidal. Two lone pairs make it bent.
Type the shape name, such as tetrahedral.
Carbon has 4 bonds and 0 lone pairs.

similar_problem.hint: Nitrogen has 3 bonds and 1 lone pair.

problems.why: Count groups, then drop the lone pairs from the name.
hints: Name the atoms you see, not the electron-group geometry.
